facts.fact: The Commission's 26 June 2026 notice applies section 32 of the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 and GAID 2025 to Data Protection Officers.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission is acting as the body administering the Act, issuing notices and verifying Data Protection Officers.
The Commission issued guidance on 26 June 2026 setting a CPD points regime for verified Data Protection Officers, and keeps a database in which DPOs are enrolled.
